posts.body: The filename of the spider should end at %12. Or maybe it was 12%. Whatever it is, is specified in the help section. But the filename is what it is all about.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
a character should be x frames wide.
like a character of 4x2 (normal default) should have x frames
like 8 down on a normal sheet should have 32 frames in total with
the name of "NAME_HERE%(8)" which has 8 frames for DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT and UP.
a single actor sheet has just 8, so keep that in mind as he has a demo on how
to use it as well.
so if you have 12 frames, use 48 in total. like "NAME_HERE%(12)"  (without quotes)

yes, down, left, right, up = 4 rows, you just need the widht / frames.
as default is 3x4 per actor, the 4 is static, as galv have diagonal too, it uses
the bottom for diagonal and top for 4dir.
the width is most important in this case, it's fairly easy to use.
same as Shaz_MoreCharacterFrames which use NAME[5,5,5,5]  inside brackets
with which can be 8 for down, 3 for left, right and 8 up  so it will be NAME[8,3,3,8]
because % can give trouble based on the HTML networking rule
